text:
Eli - New Hire: Hi team, new MacBook Air arrived. I'm at the setup assistant step but I don't see the "Company Setup" screen and there's no MDM profile after login. Also when I try to turn on FileVault it says 'FileVault cannot be enabled'. Anyone know the usual fix?
Nina (IT): Welcome Eli! Did you sign in with Okta during setup? If you created a local account before Okta, DEP flow can skip.
Eli - New Hire: I signed in with my personal Apple ID first then created the company account later. Could that cause it?
Jon - EngInfra: Yup that will do it. Two options: we can remote-trigger re-enroll via Jamf if the device is in DEP, or you can wipe and re-run Setup Assistant. If you want to avoid wipe, DM me the serial and I'll try a remote re-enroll.
Eli - New Hire: Serial is A1B2C3D4E5F6. Try please, would rather not erase.
Onboard Bot: Ticket ONB-900 created for device A1B2C3D4E5F6. ETA 3 hours.
Nina (IT): Also granting temporary admin for 4 hours to allow installs while we fix MDM. Eli, confirm manager approval in thread.
Eli - New Hire: Manager is Priya — she approves.
Nina (IT): Temp admin enabled. You should be able to run installers and enable necessary dev tools. Note: FileVault will still be enforced after MDM applies; we'll revoke admin after.
Jon - EngInfra: Jamf re-enroll pushed. If you have flaky wifi, try connecting to wired ethernet or different network; APNS calls sometimes fail on captive portals. Run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste if it still says none.
Eli - New Hire: Rebooted and now I see "Remote Management" prompt, accepted. `profiles` shows MDM present.
Jon - EngInfra: Great. We'll push the FileVault profile now; it may ask for a restart.
Onboard Bot: ONB-900 updated: Enrollment success and FileVault profile queued. Temporary admin scheduled to auto-revoke in 4 hours.
Eli - New Hire: Restarted and FileVault enabling message appeared. All good, Docker installed with sudo. Thanks!
Nina (IT): Closing ticket in 24h if no further issues. Welcome aboard! :tada:
